rdfs:label: FormalOrganization
rdfs:comment: An ORG FormalOrganization — an organization with legal recognition (company, government body, registered nonprofit).
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:Organization`. Distinguishes legally-recognized entities from informal collectives (which stay at the `Organization` level). Use when legal status matters — contracts, regulatory filings, official records. Pair with `urn:solid:identifier` (dcterms:identifier) for the registration number, as in the example; `org:identifier` is a different property (a skos:notation subproperty using a typed literal for the scheme).

history.note: Notes now match the example: urn:solid:identifier is dcterms:identifier, distinct from org:identifier.
